AccountProfile.title: AccountProfile
AccountProfile.description: Separate seller or buyer account profile linked to the authenticated Google user.

role.description: Active application portal role: SELLER or BUYER.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StoreConfig.title: StoreConfig
StoreConfig.description: Seller storefront location, delivery zone, out-of-stock visibility, and anti-theft delete protection settings.

userId.description: Authenticated seller UID owning this store.

showOutOfStock.description: Whether out-of-stock items are visible to buyers.

deleteProtectionEnabled.description: Server-enforced anti-theft delete protection lock preventing product or review deletion while active.

otpProtectionEnabled.description: Requires 6-digit OTP verification before deleting or changing store/inventory data.

lowStockThreshold.description: Minimum stock unit threshold below or equal to which low-inventory highlights and push alerts trigger.

lowStockAlertsEnabled.description: Whether automated low-stock alerts and push notifications are enabled for the seller.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A grocery or puja samagri inventory item managed by a seller and visible to buyers.

userId.description: Authenticated seller UID owning this product.

name.description: Display name of the grocery or puja item.

category.description: Product category: GROCERY, PUJA, or FANCY.

unit.description: Packaging or measurement unit (e.g., 500g, 1 pack, 1 L).

inStock.description: Visibility status indicating whether the item is currently in stock.

description.description: Optional short description of the item.

imageTag.description: Optional preset visual category tag for fallback artwork.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SellerOrder.title: SellerOrder
SellerOrder.description: A buyer grocery and puja order tracked by both buyer and seller.

buyerId.description: Buyer UID who placed this order.

deliveryMethod.description: Verification method used to confirm delivery (OTP or PHOTO).

deliveryProofUri.description: Optional delivery proof photo URI when confirmed via photograph.

riderLat.description: Optional live courier/order latitude during delivery.

riderLng.description: Optional live courier/order longitude during delivery.

riderUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of last live delivery GPS coordinate update.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StoreFeedback.title: StoreFeedback
StoreFeedback.description: Buyer star rating and feedback comment for a seller store.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Tamper-proof append-only inventory and security audit event for anti-theft protection.

sellerId.description: Authenticated seller UID owning this audit log.

action.description: Short action code (e.g. STOCK_ADJUST, CREATE_ITEM, DELETE_ITEM, LOCK_CHANGE, BACKUP_EXPORT).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

BuyerAddress.title: BuyerAddress
BuyerAddress.description: Saved buyer delivery address stored privately under the buyer account.

label.description: Address label e.g. Home, Work, Other.

defaultAddress.description: Whether this is the default checkout delivery address.

PreferredPaymentMethod.title: PreferredPaymentMethod
PreferredPaymentMethod.description: Buyer preferred payment method metadata (UPI handle, COD, card label, or wallet) with zero sensitive PAN/CVV storage.

displayLabel.description: Friendly display label e.g. Primary GPay or Pay at Doorstep.

handleOrHint.description: Optional non-sensitive UPI ID, wallet note, or masked card label.

defaultMethod.description: Whether this is the default payment preference at checkout.

WishlistItem.title: WishlistItem
WishlistItem.description: Buyer-saved favorite puja or grocery product for later purchase.

userId.description: Authenticated buyer UID owning this wishlist item.

sellerId.description: Seller store UID offering this product.

category.description: Product category: GROCERY, PUJA, or FANCY.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/accounts/{userId}.description: Private user account profile storing active Seller or Buyer portal role.

/accounts/{userId}/addresses/{addressId}.description: Private saved delivery addresses belonging to a buyer account.

/accounts/{userId}/paymentMethods/{metho.description: Private preferred payment methods belonging to a buyer account.

/stores/{sellerId}.description: Seller storefront metadata, Google Maps zone, out-of-stock visibility, and delete protection lock.

/stores/{sellerId}/products/{productId}.description: Seller's grocery and puja products readable by buyers and editable only by the seller.

/stores/{sellerId}/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Buyer ratings and feedback for the seller store.

/stores/{sellerId}/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable append-only anti-theft inventory and security audit trail.

/accounts/{userId}/wishlist/{itemId}.description: Buyer's private saved wishlist of puja and grocery items.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Marketplace orders scoped by buyerId and sellerId.
